actual_manual_comparison: Actually compared the original and complete unchanged raw output, paired sheet and white/cyan composites. Very high receding/bald crown, sparse gray side hair/brows, dark moustache and short dark chin/jaw detail retained. Serious restrained mouth, dark brown/black traditional robe and broad cream overlapping inner collar remain; fine source chin pixels are not expanded into a long beard. Compact round mascot head and short broad neck fit the widened original collar without clipping, long pillar neck or white belly at neckline. The dark frame, shaded internal backing and aged lower-right paper are retained; exterior transparency is intentional. Whole-image alpha extrema are [0, 255]. Finite interior sampling is numerical support only, not a claim of globally255 interiors. Composites show no material internal holes. Release eligibility remains subject to the current independent exclusion audit. Art approval only; native derivatives and live-game acceptance are separate.
